data.desc: Eltek - 'Innovation Across the Board' - is a leading Israeli manufacturer of advanced printed circuit boards (PCBs), serving customers worldwide in demanding, technology-driven industries. Founded in 1970, the Company specializes in the design and manufacture of complex, high-reliability PCBs, including HDI, multilayer, rigid-flex and flexible boards, for mission-critical applications. Eltek serves leading customers in the defense, aerospace, medical and other advanced industries across Israel, North America, Europe and Asia. The Company combines advanced manufacturing capabilities, engineering expertise and internationally recognized quality standards, including AS9100D and NADCAP Electronics, to deliver high-performance solutions where quality and reliability are essential. Eltek is ITAR compliant.
